qs.q: This sporeformer contaminates meats and vegetables and is the causative agent of gas gangrene
qs.e: Clostridium perfringens is the main cause of gas gangrene.

qs.q: A patient develops gas gangrene after a crushing injury. The organism most likely responsible is
qs.e: C. perfringens produces alpha toxin (lecithinase/phospholipase C) causing myonecrosis with gas production in deep traumatic wounds. The infection progresses rapidly with crepitus, systemic toxicity, and high mortality if untreated.
